stem:
Leighton made a table that correctly shows the attributes of shapes. She used a check mark to identify the attributes of each shape.

Which table could be the one Leighton made?

options.label: A
options.text:
Has Vertices: Rectangle ✓, Triangle ✓, Circle 
Quadrilateral: Rectangle ✓, Triangle ✓, Circle

options.label: B
options.text:
Has Vertices: Rectangle , Triangle , Circle ✓
Quadrilateral: Rectangle ✓, Triangle , Circle

options.label: C
options.text:
Has Vertices: Rectangle ✓, Triangle ✓, Circle 
Quadrilateral: Rectangle ✓, Triangle , Circle

options.label: D
options.text:
Has Vertices: Rectangle ✓, Triangle ✓, Circle 
Quadrilateral: Rectangle , Triangle , Circle

visual_elements: Four tables labeled A, B, C, and D, each showing three shapes (rectangle, triangle, circle) across columns and two attributes (Has Vertices, Quadrilateral) in rows, with check marks corresponding to shape attributes.
difficulty_rationale: The problem requires understanding and applying geometric concepts about vertices and quadrilaterals to identify the correct table, involving multiple attributes and shapes.
